$comment-enet: ENet is deferred (architecture.md Law 9). Add it here when net/ un-defers, together with the sr_net CMake target.
$comment-glfw3: Not used directly, and already a transitive dependency of raylib. Declared explicitly because CMakeLists.txt has to link it by hand on static triplets: raylib is built with USE_EXTERNAL_GLFW=ON but never exports glfw in its link interface, so libraylib.a ships undefined glfw* symbols. See the comment above find_package(glfw3) for why the condition is static-vs-shared rather than per-OS.
